goal: Stop fee-bumped wallet transactions from receiving a locktime older than the original transaction
Eliminates an unnatural on-chain fingerprint that identifies Bitcoin Core and Electrum wallets
reviewability: Ready to review now despite merge conflicts in the bumpfee functional test
The rebase is mechanical and does not invalidate logic review
agreement: Unaddressed objection: test restores mocktime with tip time instead of node mocktime (polespinasa)
Contested suggestion to place locktime logic inside the anti-fee-sniping block (achow101)
Tested and approved after fixing earlier stale-chain and off-by-one bugs (molnard, nervana21)
Approach approved while requesting additional test coverage for normal replacements (polespinasa)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it removes a wallet fingerprint that leaks transaction origin during fee bumps
The privacy leak occurs in under two percent of replacements so the fix is minor and deferrable
